reason: Inside one chat turn every routing request re-sent every earlier tool result with no pruning, so a long agentic turn on a finite window outgrew it and _ensure_request_capacity failed the whole turn with ChatConfigurationError; the operator got nothing and none of the results reached the next turn (HIST-3: 13 tool calls of ~7 KB on a 32K window, 31236 estimated input tokens > 30720, turn failed). A provider-side context-length rejection after a tool ran could not be recovered either: _recover_context_length_rejection only rebuilds the conversation and re-sends the same tool results, its no-repeat guard read prepared.turn, which the routing loop refreshes only after each routing reply (a lag of one step, so a fresh turn rejected at step 2 skipped the guard while a later step or a resumed turn hit it; ROUTE-13), and the final synthesis streamed provider.stream directly with no recovery at all. Now _with_tool_history builds every routing and synthesis request: while the request exceeds the model's target input it replays the oldest results as a compact receipt (status, output_cleared, durable tool_call_id, result_summary, artifact ids, and a note to use tool_output.search/tool_output.read), found by bisection, keeping the newest result whole up to the input capacity; every call keeps its result, id, batch group and replayed reasoning (opencode clears old tool output the same way, Codex compacts mid-turn). A routing request that still cannot fit ends routing and the turn answers from its results instead of failing. _recover_context_length_rejection reads the current turn and, for a request carrying tool results, first returns one retry with all but the newest result cleared (the newest too when nothing else is left), which runs no tool again; the conversation rebuild and its no-repeat refusal are unchanged otherwise. The synthesis stream is wrapped in _stream_with_context_recovery. tests/v3/test_in_turn_context_pruning.py: a 20 x 7 KB turn on a 32K window completes with every request within capacity and the oldest results replaced by receipts; routing-only overhead that cannot fit ends in an answer from the results; the real OpenAI-compatible adapter behind a wire that answers HTTP 400 context_length_exceeded for routing step 3 and for the synthesis retries each once with the older result cleared and no tool rerun; and a rejection with nothing left to clear reads the current turn. All four fail on origin/main (capacity error, capacity error, 'will not repeat tool work', 'could not be reassembled safely'). The selected existing node ids cover the conversation-level context recovery, goal fitting and batching in the routing loop, the synthesis stream paths now inside the recovery wrapper, and the #502 replay grouping, reasoning and screenshot placement that the cleared history must keep.

No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through chat.py) never runs a tool turn long enough to reach the context window or a provider context rejection; the Python tests drive the tool loop directly. No full suites.
